text: こどもに　さいみんじゅつを　かけて　どこかへ　つれさるじけんが　あった。

structure.jp: こどもに　さいみんじゅつを　かけて
structure.en: using Hypnosis on a child, and

structure.jp: どこかへ　つれさるじけんが
structure.en: an incident of taking them away somewhere

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こどもに　さいみんじゅつを　かけて　どこかへ　つれさるじけん
patterns.explanation: Everything before じけん describes what kind of incident it was. どこかへ　つれさるじけん = 'an incident in which it took them away somewhere'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one: first this, then that. さいみんじゅつを　かけて　つれさる = 'uses Hypnosis and takes them away'.
